objective: Complete Gate 3.2 under the owner's original artist topology standard: each matched attachment within +/-20% vertices, meaningful outer/inner wiring similarity, independent static coverage checks, no prior Gate regression and a portable production-facing mesh command.

priorReviewHistory.status: historical approval under superseded one-sided rule

inScope: Extract numeric topology profile from the same original Spine 4.0.64 attachment and exact-size PNG, then generate static MeshSpec from current alpha pixels.
Apply +/-20% per matched artist vertex count as a deterministic pre-Jev gate, plus separate <=2% static alpha coverage and independent MeshSpec validation.
Measure artist topology proximity and regressions; provide a portable numeric profile to the public mesh-png/mesh-asset CLI.
outOfScope: Bones, weights, animated deformation, head deform, exact artist edge or coordinate copying, production-art signoff, private source files in Git
implementationSummary: The dev-only reference checker reads an exact Spine 4.0.64 skin/slot/attachment and matching PNG, checks dimensions, derives total/hull counts and dimensionless interior row/span ratios, and saves a small <id>.profile.json outside Git. Mesh receives only these generic numbers and recomputes coordinates from the input raster. The existing CLI now accepts --reference-profile=<numeric-json> on mesh-png and mesh-asset; it never parses Spine. A generic no-reference caller gets the exact same serialized output as before. The local +/-20% check runs before Jev and cannot be overridden by its probabilistic scores.

checks.name: End-to-end portable CLI and independent synthetic tests
checks.evidence: A real profile generated from the private house Spine reference was passed to the built CLI with the original SC_House_B.png, explicit 0.5% cleanup and rigid intent. CLI output has 25 vertices/29 triangles, and every vertex, UV, triangle and hull index exactly equals the independently run reference-checker mesh; source PNG unchanged and cleanup counts 17 discarded. A portable CLI integration test uses a synthetic numeric reference profile without any private material: it verifies ten vertices/four hull, diagnostics, source preservation, malformed profile rejection and nonmesh command rejection. The synthetic broad reference-profile fixture separately tests numeric band levels, topology, <=2% foreground/background raster coverage, source-independent repeatability and 100 byte-identical runs. Full npm run verify passes formatter, lint, TypeScript and 50 tests in seven files.

checks.name: Matched artist vertex and visual topology evidence
checks.evidence: Beard: original and generated 24 vertices, all 24 boundary and zero interior, 22 triangles. House: original and generated 25 vertices, 19 boundary plus six interior, 29 triangles. Each deviation is 0%, within +/-20%. Developer inspected exact source/old/new overlays. Using dimensionless artist bands moved the house six inner control points near the artist's upper cornice, mid-body and lower plinth: symmetric nearest interior distance 43.9309 px before to 2.8183 px after, hull 5.3380 px. Beard hull nearest distance 2.8238 px. Vertex count is not the sole criterion; differences remain: beard four triangles under 10 degrees vs artist zero, house five vs artist twelve; edges are not exact copies.

checks.name: Independent alpha and MeshSpec validity
checks.evidence: Independent pixel-center coverage and validator on exact private PNGs after explicit 0.5% cleanup: beard foreground 882, 16 missed and 16 transparent added (1.8141% each); house foreground 51,606, 112 missed (0.2170%) and 423 added (0.8197%). Both generated meshes pass the independent MeshSpec validator, and each private case repeated 100 times byte-identically.

checks.name: Prior Gate regression and architecture
checks.evidence: For beard, house and Tail, recomputed meshes with no artist profile are each full JSON.stringify byte-identical to their private pre-repair saved verified32 meshes: every vertex, UV, triangle and hull index. Tail's approved profile remains 24 vertices/27 triangles and exact 1297 missed / 306 added of 81,641 foreground. Portable starter-after-profile exact output test and old golden/CLI/schema/negative tests pass. Mesh package dependencies remain only schemas, TypeBox and Earcut, TypeScript project references only schemas, and a package-boundary test confirms no Spine, assets, core or Jev import in Mesh. The Spine reference parser is a dev-only tool, CLI sees numeric JSON only, no IR schema or runtime dependency changed.

Exact outer/inner distributions and triangles; house inner point distance 2.82 px after measured improvement, with edge/angle differences disclosed.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Static coverage, legal topology and 100-run determinism
definitionOfDone.evidence: Separate <=2% errors, independent validator, three real 100-run repeat checks and synthetic profile coverage checks.
Developer profile export, built CLI consumes numeric profile on the real house and matches reference-tool mesh index-for-index; synthetic CLI integration and 50 total tests pass.
Three exact no-profile serialized mesh comparisons, portable regression tests, numeric-only engine input and package-boundary test.

knownLimitations: The artist profile requires a matching original reference; an unknown asset produces a review-required starter mesh
Skinny beard triangles and nonidentical edges need later artist/deformation review, with no dynamic approval implied
